en:
You can trust a dishonest man to be dishonest.
It's the honest ones you wanna watch out for...

Cuz you can never predict when they're
gonna do something...incredibly stupid.

It's honestly easier to go through life without
telling a single lie.

Which means honest people are just lazy jerks
who'd rather coast through life.

By the way, the recent trend of encouraging
honesty is actually a lie.

You see, it's better for liars if there are more
honest people in the world to deceive.

They've been lying about that trend so there
can be more stupid honest people.
...But that might be a lie, too. Puhuhuhuhu.

Um... This is an official announcement from the
Ultimate Academy. It is now 8 a.m.

Where...did he run off to? Probably with
some other woman, I bet.

But...that's fine. As long as he's happy, I'm
fine with that.

Maybe not today, but someday...I'm gonna
be happy too!
Urghhh... Nrghhh...
D-Darling! What's the matter!?
Monophanie... I...finally remember...
I need you, Monophanie!

...Too convenient, huh? I know I'll only hurt
you more by saying stuff like that...
...I'm sorry for everything. Goodbye...
Wait...you silly man.
Huh?

My goodness...your body is coming apart.
You really can't do anything on your own.
Alright, come here. I'll sew you back up.
Th-Thank you...Monophanie.
*sniffle* Thank...you... *sniffle*

*sniffle*... Why are you crying?
That's...so not like you... *sniffle*

<CLT=cltMIND>What the hell kind of <CLT=cltSTRONG>ending<CLT=cltMIND> was that?
And that was way too long for an announcement.

Ah, well...
I need to go to the dining hall.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.

<CLT=cltMIND>The bed is starting to feel more comfortable,
I just might prefer it over futons...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>So many identical uniforms
in my closet...

<CLT=cltMIND>That kind of preparation must mean
that they were targeting us.
